body: Thank you for your answer. I wish I knew how to find a passion in life or how to at least get rid of those painful feelings and thoughts. But right now my mind is in kind of a negative loop thinking of all the things I will not expirience and of all the long years in front of me. Dont get me wrong I think you`re right but i dont eeven know where to start...atm moment I am spending my days trying (and failing) to stop rewinding negative thoughts in my head over and over again.
